title: Miami City Tour with Little Havana and Wynwood Stops
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels

Shared experience and shared transportation. Airboat rides and alligator shows are conducted in English. On-route commentary available in English / Spanish / German. Extended courtesy stops outside the free pickup zones may be possible; small supplement fee may apply. Downtown Miami area. Miami Beach area.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore and learn about Miami’s iconic neighborhoods, vibrant culture, and stunning skyline views. Discover Cuban traditions, colorful street art, Art Deco landmarks, coffee, cigars, and local stories.

Stroll along famous Ocean Drive and admire the colorful Art Deco architecture
Learn about the transformation of Wynwood through the vision of Tony Goldman
Experience Miami through its people, culture, traditions, and neighborhoods
Immerse yourself in Cuban heritage and learn about cigars, coffee and music
Enjoy spectacular skyline views and the most scenic photo locations all over
